examples.title: Basic checkbox group
examples.description: Grouped checkboxes under a shared legend with independent checked states.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Checkbox } from '@lostgradient/cinder/checkbox';
  import { CheckboxGroup } from '@lostgradient/cinder/checkbox-group';

  let email = $state(true);
  let sms = $state(false);
  let push = $state(false);
</script>

<CheckboxGroup label="Notification channels">
  <Checkbox id="email" label="Email" bind:checked={email} />
  <Checkbox id="sms" label="SMS" bind:checked={sms} />
  <Checkbox id="push" label="Push notifications" bind:checked={push} />
</CheckboxGroup>

examples.title: Disabled checkbox group
examples.description: A disabled CheckboxGroup dims every child checkbox through the native fieldset cascade, with no per-checkbox disabled prop.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Checkbox } from '@lostgradient/cinder/checkbox';
  import { CheckboxGroup } from '@lostgradient/cinder/checkbox-group';
</script>

<CheckboxGroup label="Notification channels" disabled>
  <Checkbox id="disabled-fieldset-email" label="Email" checked />
  <Checkbox id="disabled-fieldset-sms" label="SMS" />
</CheckboxGroup>
